April 12, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Harding Loevner Lp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 60.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Harding Loevner Lp sold 2.01 million shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.29 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $218.16 million, down from 3.30M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Harding Loevner Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $874.96B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $172.44. About 20.21 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Crispin Odey increased its stake in Rowan Companies Plc (RDC) by 93.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd bought 4.91M shares as the company’s stock declined 25.51% with the market. The hedge fund run by Crispin Odey held 10.14 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $158.79M, up from 5.23M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Odey Asset Management Group Ltd who had been investing in Rowan Companies Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.86 billion market cap company. The stock increased 5.55% or $0.77 during the last trading session, reaching $14.64. About 3.06 million shares traded or 3.05% up from the average. Rowan Companies plc (NYSE:RDC) has declined 22.59% since April 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.14% the S&P500.
